[/color][/center][/b][i]Your sprinklers finally have… personality. 
[/i]

[quote]“Wow… this could be way more interesting.”[/quote][b]
Dynamic Sprinkler[/b] brings life (and humor) to your irrigation system by giving every sprinkler a [i]daily mood[/i].

Each morning, your sprinklers secretly roll a personality and change the way they behave on your farm!

[line]🎭 [b]What This Mod Does

[/b]Every in-game morning, each sprinkler chooses a random “personality action” based on configurable chances:


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39895/39895-1766002816-1768030989.png[/img]


[line]💧 [b]💤 Lazy Mode — Might Skip Watering Tiles

[/b]Sometimes your sprinkler wakes up and decides

[quote]“Not today.”[/quote][list]
[*]Randomly leaves [b]1–N tiles dry[/b]
[*]Uses your normal coverage, just… slightly worse
[*]Fully configurable
[/list][line]🌊 [b]💦 Generous Mode — Waters Extra Tiles

[/b]A helpful sprinkler that goes above and beyond!

[list]
[*]Waters [b]extra farmland[/b] outside its normal radius
[*]Perfect for irregular farm layouts
[*]Radius & number of bonus tiles fully configurable
[/list][line]🔥 [b]🌱 Growth Spurts — Boost Crop Growth

[/b]Your sprinkler becomes a hype coach:

[quote]“Grow faster, little buddy!”[/quote][list]
[*]Random crops in range advance their growth phase
[*]Cuts [b]1 day[/b] off their current stage
[*]Never affects harvest-ready crops
[*]Completely customizable
[/list][line]🧪 [b]🪴 Free Fertilizer — Rare Bonus Treatment

[/b]Feeling generous, your sprinkler may:

[list]
[*]Pick [b]one watered tile[/b]
[*]Apply [b]any fertilizer item ID you specify[/b]
[*]Default = Basic Fertilizer (368)
[*]Fully configurable
[/list][line]🌊 [b]⚠️ Overflow Mode — Splash Beyond Normal Range

[/b]When chaos strikes:

[list]
[*]Water spills [b]outside the normal sprinkler pattern[/b]
[*]Random tiles in a bigger radius get soaked
[*]Amount & radius are configurable
[/list][line]🧠 [b]Stable, Seeded Randomness

[/b]Sprinklers behave the same way each time you load the same [i]in-game day[/i].

No time-of-day or machine randomness!

Perfect stability + fun personality.

[line]🎛️ [b]Full GMCM Support [/b](Can be configured from [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b])

[list]
[*]Water skip chance
[*]Extra water chance, radius, tiles
[*]Fertilizer chance & item ID
[*]Overflow chance, radius, tiles
[*]Growth spurt chance & tiles
[*]Debug logging toggle
[*][i]Everything customizable[/i]
[/list][line]🌾 [b]Why You’ll Love It[/b]✔ Makes sprinklers feel alive

✔ Adds unpredictability without ruining efficiency

✔ Fully configurable — can be silly, balanced, or chaotic

✔  only changes behavior, not objects
[line]📦 Installation[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b]

[*]Drop [code]LazySprinkler[/code] into your [code]Mods[/code] folder

[*][i](Optional)[/i] Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for in-game settings

[/list][line]💬 Final Notes

This mod turns your irrigation system into a dynamic, personality-driven helper that keeps farming fresh without becoming annoying.

Perfect for players who want [b]more life[/b], [b]more humor[/b], and [b]more surprises[/b] in their day-to-day routine.
